subtitle: A real rule language, checking what Chapter 3's pipeline assumes

eyebrow: A DQDL ruleset — case-sensitive, square brackets
code:
Rules = [
   IsComplete "customer_id",
   IsUnique "order_id",
   RowCount > 0,
   ColumnValues "order_total" > 0,
   Completeness "email_address" > 0.95
]
caption: IsComplete / IsUnique already return true-or-false; others need an expression

eyebrow: The DQDL rule builder in Glue Studio
caption: 18 rule types, with live validation — this one flags a syntax error before you run it

code:
Rules = [
   (IsComplete "order_id") and (IsUnique "order_id"),

   ColumnValues "country_code" in ["US","CA","MX"]
     with threshold > 0.98
]
caption: By default each side evaluates independently across the whole column, not row-by-row
